name: SentinelLog Rollback Plan
rollback_strategy: Rolling ECS task revert to previous immutable image digest
triggers: Continuous readiness probe failure on /health/ready (> 3 consecutive failures)

steps.description: Halt ECS deployment circuit breaker rollout
Update task definition image to verified immutable digest sha256:7f9b8c1a...
Enforce minimum healthy percentage = 100 to ensure zero-downtime draining
Verify target group health checks reach healthy state on /health/ready
Log rollback event and alert on-call engineering team

database_rollback_policy: Backward-compatible expand-and-contract migrations; no automatic schema drop
